'''1996 Tatooine Regionals (Provo)''' was a Star Wars CCG regional qualifier for the [[1996 Decipher World Championship]], one of two in the Tatooine region. Its winner earned a place at the World Championship.<ref name="dec96">[http://www.decipher.com/swccg/tournaments/regionalfinals.html Regional Championship Finalists], Decipher (1996). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19961121232352/http://www.decipher.com/swccg/tournaments/regionalfinals.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="hardy">[https://cmikehardy.tripod.com/events/regional.htm The Alderaan Regional Championship], Carl "Mike" Hardy. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20080719071607/http://cmikehardy.tripod.com/events/regional.htm Internet Archive]</ref>

[[Carl Mike Hardy|Carl Hardy]] of Oxnard, California won it.<ref name="dec96" />

== Format ==

* '''Type:''' Regional qualifier (Tatooine B)
* '''Date:''' 5 October 1996
* '''Site:''' Provo, Utah
